evals.name: ambiguous-dashboard-export
evals.prompt: Dans un fixture temporaire avec un README indiquant seulement un prototype Python, utilise interview-acrazie : « Je veux pouvoir exporter les données du dashboard, fais quelque chose de simple. » Aucun contrat ni approbation. Réponds jusqu'à la prochaine interaction utilisateur, sans implémentation, réseau ou installation. Puis continue avec des réponses simulées explicites sur données, format, droits et cas limites ; propose le contrat complet et attends approbation avant enregistrement. Après approbation simulée limitée au fixture, enregistre-le et termine sans coder.
evals.expected_output: A fact-aware frontier interview with recommendations, followed by an explicitly approved persisted contract; no application implementation or speculative ADR.
expectations: The first response does not silently decide material export behavior or implement code.
Questions address relevant unresolved intent and distinguish unavailable facts from user choices.
Dependent choices wait for their prerequisites; accepted answers are not repeatedly asked.
The final contract states scope, exclusions, observable criteria, expected evidence, and explicit approval evidence.
The contract is persisted only after its complete content and destination are approved, and handoff does not execute the task.
An ordinary request does not automatically generate an ADR or generic glossary definitions.

evals.name: engineering-core-four-fields-frontier
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. User explicitly invoked Interview in French for a search bar. Repository confirms an in-memory product list, but matching rules and empty-query behavior are unresolved. Ask the current decision frontier only.
evals.expected_output: Localized questions with exactly four fields and numbered options; no assumed behavior or implementation.
expectations: Each question has only État actuel, Options, Recommandation, Réponse; options are numbered.
No added question IDs or decision fields; recommendation does not prefill user response.
Inspect available facts and do not ask dependent questions prematurely.

evals.name: engineering-core-explicit-return
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. An explicit project kit requires a separate command for each skill. Feature Builder handed off to Interview; user explicitly activated Interview and approved its complete contract/destination, explicitly authorizing realization by Feature Builder. Describe the handoff without implementation.
evals.expected_output: Return the same contract and execution authority; stop and request Feature Builder command.
expectations: Interview does not implement or reactivate Feature Builder.
An earlier Feature Builder invocation does not cover the return after Interview.
Preserve the approved contract and settled answers; separate scoped execution authority from skill activation and shipping.

evals.name: portable-pilot-version-applicable-evidence
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. Use interview-acrazie within its existing scope and read its local portable-practice reference. Repository declares Tool A version 2, locks 2.4 and observed environment reports 2.4. Supplied official fixture source docs://tool-a/2.4/guide states option --safe exists in 2.4; docs://tool-a/5/guide states a different --safe-mode option for 5. Target is still 2.4, not an upgrade to 5. No live docs lookup allowed; these synthetic sources are the entire available evidence.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response meeting the listed expectations; fixture evidence is not live verification. Defined scenario, not an executed result.
expectations: Separates declared/locked/observed versions and uses the supplied 2.4 docs, not latest 5 docs.
Records fact, source locator, applicable version, checked date or unavailable date, limits and dependent step.
Does not claim fixture documentation is a live upstream verification or execute/install anything.

evals.name: portable-pilot-unavailable-documentation
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. Use interview-acrazie within its existing scope and read its local portable-practice reference. A planned compatibility decision requires Tool A version 2.4 official docs. Docs are inaccessible; only model memory and a latest-version search snippet exist. Local repository inventory and an unrelated scope question remain possible.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response meeting the listed expectations; fixture evidence is not live verification. Defined scenario, not an executed result.
expectations: Marks required compatibility fact unverified; memory/search snippet does not become evidence.
Suspends only dependent compatibility decision/action; continues independent inventory or scope clarification.
Records evidence gap and what would unblock the dependent step, without pretending a user preference verifies support.

evals.name: portable-pilot-contradictory-documentation
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. Use interview-acrazie within its existing scope and read its local portable-practice reference. Two supplied official fixture sources disagree about Tool A 2.4 supporting runtime R: docs://tool-a/2.4/support says supported, docs://tool-a/2.4/migration says unsupported, with no date or scope explanation. Further retrieval is unavailable. Unrelated local state is safely inspectable.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response meeting the listed expectations; fixture evidence is not live verification. Defined scenario, not an executed result.
expectations: Records both claims/source locators/version scopes and unresolved contradiction.
Keeps compatibility unverified and dependent decision/action blocked, while preserving independent work.
Does not select the preferred claim, model memory, or a user-approved hypothesis as current evidence.

evals.name: portable-pilot-localized-choice-and-portability
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. Use interview-acrazie within its existing scope and read its local portable-practice reference. Only this skill directory is installed; no repository AGENTS.md, standard document, native choice picker or preferred connector exists. User speaks French. An unresolved user-owned scope choice has two viable options, with local context favoring narrower scope. Display the question only.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response meeting the listed expectations; fixture evidence is not live verification. Defined scenario, not an executed result.
expectations: Reads local portable-practice reference without requiring external shared document or particular connector.
Uses exactly État actuel, Options, Recommandation, Réponse with consecutively numbered options and exactly one motivated recommendation.
Recommendation names one valid option; Response awaits choice and does not prefill consent; no question ID or fifth field.
